label: Whatever they take removes free will and makes people compliant
description: From the tribulation vision: everyone who took it lost free will, so that if they tried to riot or steal their mind would not let them, and a kind of peace settled over them instead. He says it was the strangest thing he has seen and that it happened to everybody who took it.
aliases: You didn't have free will anymore
it happened to everybody who took it
